'''Jehannah''' is the capital of [[Ghealdan]] and the location of the royal residence, the [[Jheda Palace]].

==Location==
It was built on the site of [[Shanaine]], formerly a part of [[Manetheren]].{{ref/book|bwb}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Shanaine}} It lies on the [[River Boern]].{{ref/book|5|49}}

==Recent events==
In {{ne|999}}, after [[Rand al'Thor]] fought [[Ishamael]] at [[Falme]], [[Moiraine Damodred]] sent [[Uno Nomesta]] and his [[Shienaran]] soldiers to a contact of hers in Jehannah.{{ref/book|3|6}} When they arrived in Jehannah, however, the contact was dead and they decided to go their own way.{{ref/book|5|38}}

Both [[Faile Bashere]] and Lord [[Orban]] wintered in Jehannah when [[Hunter of the Horn|hunting]] for the [[Horn of Valere]].{{ref/book|3|35}}

When evading the [[Seanchan]], [[Matrim Cauthon]]'s [[Redarm]]s left rumors that they were heading toward Jehannah. [[Furyk Karede]] saw through the this ruse.{{ref/book|10|4}}

Before the [[Battle of Malden]], [[Perrin Aybara]] ordered the servants and camp followers to head to the [[Jehannah Road]] and deliver Queen [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]] in Jehannah.{{ref/book|11|29}}
